feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 21 September 2026 5:12am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 21 September 2026 at 5:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the south of England covers the area, as a low near Greenland drives a week warm front across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle at first, becoming mainly fair. Risk of mist patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain, drizzle or mist patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 2 to 4, becoming cyclonic overnight into Wednesday, then mainly North or Northwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Risk of mist patches at first. Rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in mist patches, or rain later.
